en: Black‑and‑white image showing a quiet residential street lined with large shade trees on the left and a row of detached wooden houses on the right. The houses feature broad front porches with columns, gabled roofs, and decorative trim typical of early 20th‑century American architecture. A neat picket fence with rounded finials encloses a small, well‑kept front garden with shrubs and a palm. A straight concrete sidewalk runs between the fence and a dirt verge beside the road, receding into the distance. There is a wide white border around the photograph, as often seen on old postcard prints.
